# Dhdt

**Dhdt** is a płynny (ciągłe pompowanie) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/pl/formats/ore-fields/).

## Wydobycie

| Property | Wartość |
|---|---|
| Ilość / wydobycie | 450 |
| Typ wydobycia | płynny (ciągłe pompowanie) |
| Efekt aktywujący | niewymagany |
| Dokument geoskanowania | definition 8706 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
